body:
UCL_Core 96c04f7: Tavern webhook control and observability update. Inbound is separated from outbound streams; each webhook can be disabled; Admin shows per-webhook sync summary; permanent 404 webhooks no longer block healthy sync. NotifyConfig typing and C# coding standards are included.

---
